newsitem.title: RUSSIA: PRESS DIGEST - IZVESTIA - RUSSIA - MAY 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - IZVESTIA - RUSSIA - MAY 11.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the May 12 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Russia is not pressed for time in its attempts to reach an agreement with NATO over the bloc's planned eastward expansion and will sign the document only when it is ready, Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov says in an interview.
- The latest seizure of Russian journalists by unidentified gunmen in Chechnya could ruin a planned Russian-Chechen summit.
- The mutilated body of a top Russian model has been found in Greece near the villa of a top Russian contract killer who was murdered there some time ago.
